entities.name: PMID:25074339
observations: Park et al., Antioxid Redox Signal. 2015;22(1):63-77. DOI:10.1089/ars.2013.5748.
Study reports PrxII negatively regulates LPS-induced osteoclast formation and bone loss through JNK and STAT3.

entities.name: PRDX2
observations: Peroxiredoxin II (PrxII) is an antioxidant enzyme; PrxII-deficient cells exhibited increased LPS-induced ROS and osteoclast formation.

entities.name: PrxII and LPS bone loss
observations: In vitro, PrxII deficiency increased LPS-induced ROS and osteoclast formation; JNK-mediated c-Fos/NFATc1 expression and STAT3-associated IL-1β, IL-6, and NO increased.
In vivo, PrxII-deficient mice showed greater LPS-induced osteoclast formation and bone loss than wild-type mice.
